description.html: This water dish has a light grey-green color, a porous surface with darker pits and a layered rim, like a lichen-covered stone beside a stream. The water basin is wide, and the edges are uneven enough to give your animal a foothold while drinking.

The greenish tone blends naturally into tropical and forest setups with live or artificial plants, moss and bark. If you keep more active species that climb on decorations, place the dish on a level spot or press it slightly into the substrate so it does not tip over.

In a tropical terrarium, open water adds to air humidity. If you need more moisture, you can place the dish closer to the warmer side, since heat speeds up evaporation; if humidity is already high, keep it on the cooler side. Always check humidity with a hygrometer rather than guessing.
In a warm, humid environment bacteria and algae grow faster, so change the water every day and scrub the dish thoroughly at least once a week.
